top_offers.title: CTO / Co-Founder
top_offers.why: Co-founder/CTO role at an early-stage Zurich startup building a Vue.js product, close to the founding-engineer path Magino walked at Alaya, with real equity upside from day one. Listing gives little on funding stage, AI exposure or cash comp, so it's a worth-a-look lead rather than a confirmed strong fit.

note: LinkedIn cookie in /tmp/linkedin_cookie.txt was rejected by LinkedIn (HTTP 400, cookie invalidated) — searches ran on web sources only. Ran 8 distinct searches across Indeed, SwissDevJobs, Wellfound, Joinup.ch, StartupTicker, SwissAIJob, WeWorkRemotely, RemoteOK, HN Who's Hiring and LinkedIn public search, covering all 6 required role categories. Of ~20 real postings reviewed, all but 2 were already tracked in offers.json from prior runs; the second new one (NP Group, Senior Kubernetes Platform Engineer, remote EU contract via staffing agency) scored below the C threshold (grade F — poor tech/company/AI fit) and was excluded from top_offers per the 'don't inflate scores' rule.
